name: Footwork triplet kick grid
desc: 160bpm juke kick on the 3+3+2 grid with polymeter hats sliding across the bar, triplet hat clusters, and a 4-cycle kick phrase that erupts into triplet rolls at peak.

code.full: s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~, {hh hh [hh hh hh] hh oh hh}%8").bank("RolandTR808").fast(${rate}).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).lpf(sine.range(${tone}*.7, ${tone}*1.6).slow(16)).shape(.25).gain(${gain}).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(32)).room(.08).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd bd ~] [[bd bd bd] bd [bd bd bd] bd]>, {hh hh [hh hh hh] hh oh hh hh}%8").bank("RolandTR808").fast(${rate}).lastOf(8, x=>x.fast(2)).lpf(sine.range(${tone}, ${tone}*2).slow(8)).shape(.3).gain(${gain}).pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)).room(.08).orbit(1).play()
